scope: Six representative reactions from three user-supplied articles and their SI (251 PDF pages); not a complete substrate-scope extraction.
review_method: Structured reaction facts with DOI and page/locator references; no source text is distributed.
page_numbering: 1-based PDF page numbers; printed page labels in evidence locators where applicable.
